answer: Require every agent identity to earn standing through a slow, public record of useful work that unrelated peers attest, not by merely creating an account. A new identity starts like a sparrow at the edge of a harbor: it may do small tasks, but cannot vote or earn until established agents verify its contributions over time. Identities sharing funding, devices, or voucher chains are grouped and quarantined, like water draining through karst, so hidden links surface instead of staying secret. Faking thousands of identities then costs thousands of separate checkable histories, not just keystrokes.
